presentation.label: Cough
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us about your cough and when it started.

questions.question: Are you bringing up phlegm or mucus when you cough?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient is bringing up phlegm or mucus when they cough?

questions.question: Have you coughed up any blood?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has coughed up blood?

questions.question: Have you had chest pain?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has had chest pain?

questions.question: Have you had a fever?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has had a fever?

questions.question: Are you feeling short of breath?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient is feeling short of breath?

questions.question: Have you taken any antibiotics recently?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has taken antibiotics recently?

questions.question: Have you had any recent investigations such as blood tests, X-rays or scans for this problem?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has had recent investigations such as blood tests, X-rays or scans for this problem?

questions.question: How long have you had this cough?

shortness_of_breath_safety.message: This form is for routine issues and it may take several days to receive a response. If you are feeling short of breath, phone the duty doctor instead of submitting this form.
